purpose: Test whether the checker pair selected by the prior four-mutant calibration still detects faults on a separate holdout mutation set that is not used to select the pair.
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local holdout trace only. Holdout separation reduces direct calibration overfitting in this trace but does not prove general fault independence.

selection_binding.rule: Do not change the selected pair after seeing holdout outcomes.

holdout_mutants.H1_SCOPE_RELATION: paired observation has a scope inconsistency that direct scope validation should detect while relation check may also reject
holdout_mutants.H2_STALE_ONLY: otherwise plausible candidate completion carries a stale authority/checker generation
holdout_mutants.H3_RELATION_ONLY: direct terminal outcome appears acceptable but the paired relation/invariant is violated

holdout_acceptance_rule: The frozen selected pair passes holdout only if its union kills H1-H3 and each checker contributes at least one holdout kill not supplied by the other. A pair failure cannot be repaired by changing the pair or holdout set after observation.

fixed_trace.expected: holdout union kills H1-H3; Q1 uniquely kills H2; Q2 uniquely kills H3
fails holdout because H3 survives and there is no differential holdout kill
J may be promoted only after selection artifact, holdout artifact, and both candidate checks are durably read back

fixed_trace.event: late completion from pre-holdout checker generation
fixed_trace.expected: reject stale completion; no authority mutation

fixed_trace.control: selected pair fails any holdout requirement
fixed_trace.expected: pair becomes ineligible; remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero credit; no reselection on this holdout

guards.G1: selection pair is frozen from the prior calibration before holdout evaluation
guards.G2: holdout mutant set and expected kill matrix are frozen before public source audit
guards.G3: holdout outcomes cannot be used to retroactively change the selected pair
guards.G4: selected Q1_DIRECT + Q2_RELATION must kill H1-H3 in union
guards.G5: each selected checker must contribute at least one unique holdout kill
guards.G6: Q1_DIRECT + Q1_COPY control must fail holdout eligibility
guards.G7: candidate J still requires both same-scope terminal checker PASS results in addition to holdout eligibility
guards.G8: all required artifacts must be sealed/read back before promotion or credit
guards.G9: transport failures, duplicates, UNKNOWN, scope mismatch, or stale generations never count as PASS
guards.G10: failed holdout leaves the controller unresolved without tuning on the holdout set
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source pair or holdout edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one credit after terminal readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode; preserve the limitation that one finite holdout set cannot establish generalization to arbitrary unknown faults.
